header: Bedtime is a mobile app rooted in a universal ritual. It invites strangers from around the world to exchange goodnight messages. Quiet. Gentle. Intentional. In a space defined by performance, Bedtime creates a pause. A reminder that even the smallest moments of connection still matter.

text: When the creators of Bedtime came to me, I loved the idea. A simple way to connect strangers through something we all understand. What began as an experiment turned into a true collaboration. The result is a product that trades noise for calm and performance for presence. A small app with a quietly ambitious goal to make the internet feel a little more human.

Bedtime does not promise transformation. It offers something quieter. A pause, a gesture, a moment of care exchanged between strangers. It is a small product with a clear intent. And in a world that often rewards the loudest voice, that quiet feels like progress.
